headline: Colombia beat Ghana 1-0 to reach last 16 of World Cup
summary: A goal from Jhon Arias secured the victory for the South Americans, setting up a clash with Switzerland in Vancouver.
details: Colombia defeated Ghana 1-0 on Friday at Arrowhead Stadium, becoming the final team to qualify for the World Cup last 16.
The only goal of the match came in the 14th minute when Jhon Arias steered home a cross from substitute Luis Suarez.
Colombia dominated the game, completing 319 passes in the first half alone, while Ghana failed to register a single shot on target.
The match saw early injuries, with Colombia's Jhon Cordoba and Ghana's Marvin Senaya both forced off early in the game.
Despite several chances to extend their lead, including opportunities for Luis Diaz, Colombia held onto the 1-0 win.
Colombia will now face Switzerland in the knockout stages in Vancouver on Tuesday.
caption:
Colombia secures a spot in the World Cup last 16! 🇨🇴

Colombia defeated Ghana 1-0 on Friday at Arrowhead Stadium, becoming the final team to qualify for the World Cup last 16.

The only goal of the match came in the 14th minute when Jhon Arias steered home a cross from substitute Luis Suarez.

Colombia dominated the game, completing 319 passes in the first half alone, while Ghana failed to register a single shot on target.

The match saw early injuries, with Colombia's Jhon Cordoba and Ghana's Marvin Senaya both forced off early in the game.

Despite several chances to extend their lead, including opportunities for Luis Diaz, Colombia held onto the 1-0 win.

Colombia will now face Switzerland in the knockout stages in Vancouver on Tuesday.

headline: Gold prices surge in Bangladesh as JP Morgan issues forecast
summary: Gold prices have seen a significant jump, while JP Morgan provides new forecasts regarding global gold demand.
details: Gold prices in Bangladesh have experienced a significant increase, marking a sharp rise in the cost per bhori.
The price hike comes amid shifting global market trends and fluctuating demand for the precious metal.
Adding to the market volatility, JP Morgan has released a new forecast regarding the demand for gold.
Financial analysts are monitoring these developments closely to understand the long-term impact on local prices.
Consumers and investors in Bangladesh are reacting to the sudden jump in prices, affecting both jewelry purchases and investment strategies.
